course_summary:
ISEN 658 Principles of Manufacturing Processes | Fall 2026
Instructor: Dinakar Sagapuram | dinakar@tamu.edu
Meets: TR 08:00AM-09:15AM | ZACH 345
Grading: Exam 1 [25%], Exam 2 [25%], Exam 3 [25%], Final Project [25%] — A: 90%-100%, B: 80%-89.9%, C: 70%-79.9%, D: 60%-69.9%, F: < 60 %
Topics: tension test, stress tensor, principal stresses, yield criteria, plastic flow rules, nucleation, growth, cast microstructures, phase diagrams, equilibrium freezing, non-equilibrium freezing, constitutional undercooling, interface stability, 1D analysis, bulk heat treatment, Stationary heat sources, surface heat treatment, Moving heat sources, welding, laser-based processing, Contact temperatures, heat partitioning, Machining temperatures, Finite Element Method (FEM), FEM implementation, FEM applications, Finite element modeling of machining, physical principles of manufacturing processes, analytical techniques, numerical techniques, industrial manufacturing applications, case studies, solid mechanics, plastic deformation, deformation processes, cutting processes, fluid flow, rheology, polymer processing, casting, thermal effects, transient heat transfer problems, tribology, additive manufacturing processes, materials and process selection, product design, material behavior, manufacturing process mechanics, theoretical methods, physical phenomena, process performance, efficiency, product attributes, product performance, Mechanical behavior of materials, elasticity, plasticity, Deformation and forming processes, effect of friction, Solidification of metals, Solidification of alloys, Heat transfer and conduction, mathematics, science, engineering, manufacturing processes, processing
Tools: ABAQUS, course website
